cc:Work.dc:title: Strict maturity × resource-shock counterfactual
cc:Work.dc:description: Profile A deadlines: (1, 1, 3, 3); profile B: (2, 2, 2, 2). Both have mean maturity two. Shock levels are zero and two budget units. All four conditions remain together within each of 64 resampled value groups; five training seeds form the crossed factor. Initial-state witnesses are required. Bars are stored pointwise 95% intervals from 10,000 resamples, averaging four latent paths per cell. Realized terminal query draws are not used in these expected-utility intervals.
